cavity_volume.method: Actual Minecraft 1.20.1 density codecs and RandomState; compare cave air only where the identical uncarved terrain is solid, outside the protected lake band. Same sample grid as the prior expanded-volume audit.

morphology.method: Six-neighbor connected components on a two-block lattice using the actual 4x8x4 density interpolation cells. Exclude uncarved terrain air and protected continuous/quart lake columns. Exclude components touching each sampled box boundary from enclosed-component statistics.

carvers.measurement_limit: This is the analytic probability-times-cross-section budget for carved tunnels, not a measured total post-carver union volume. Small initial carver rooms, overlapping tunnels and lake clipping are not included in that equality.

limits: Finite deterministic samples do not guarantee equal cave volume for individual seeds or areas. Removing narrow passage generators and enlarging chambers strongly reduces small enclosed pockets; four small pockets remained in the sampled interpolated noise field, so there is no universal minimum cavity size. The large-region volume sample retains the prior expansion, while the nine local morphology boxes have different air volume because rooms moved and merged. Existing chunks are not rewritten.
